items.title: Etta Jones interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 2, 1998
items.q: I heard Count Basie and Duke Ellington and Jimmy Lunceford and all those people, and I went to the Apollo to see them.

ctx.x: Did the music, as you were growing up, when did you first start being aware of jazz or swing music?

Well I remember as a three year old, they tell me I used to sing the songs from the radio and as I got a little older and a little older, I heard Count Basie and Duke Ellington and Jimmy Lunceford and all those people, and I went to the Apollo to see them. And when I heard Billie Holiday that was just the end. I just said oh my God, it was haunting to me. It was just — I just wanted to be a singer. But from a little kid I used to sing all the time. What I heard I would sing, and they would ask me to sing, and at…
No problem. It wasn’t like anybody had to force you.
